source.title: SAMPLE COSTS TO ESTABLISH AN ORCHARD AND PRODUCE
source.description: Establish and Produce Almonds, Double-line Drip Irrigation
source.publisher: UC Davis Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics / UC Cooperative Extension

priceYear.quote: Sample costs given for labor, materials, equipment and contract services are based on October 2019 figures.

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical orchard consists of 105 contiguous acres of almonds farmed by the owner.

acresCrop.quote: Almonds are being established on 100 acres; roads, irrigation systems and farmstead occupy five acres.

interestRatePct.quote: The interest rate of 6 percent is used to calculate capital recovery.

operatingInterestRatePct.quote: Interest on operating capital is based on cash operating costs and is calculated monthly until harvest at a nominal rate of 5.25 percent per year.

laborMachineRate.quote: Hourly wages for workers are $18.00 for machine operators and $12.50 per hour non-machine labor.

laborNonMachineRate.quote: Hourly wages for workers are $18.00 for machine operators and $12.50 per hour non-machine labor.

fuelPriceDiesel.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $3.95 and $3.63 per gallon, respectively.

fuelPriceGas.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $3.95 and $3.63 per gallon, respectively.

costsPerAcre.title: COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE ALMONDS

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: The formula for the calculation of the annual capital recovery costs is ((Purchase Price – Salvage Value) x (Capital Recovery Factor)) + (Salvage Value x Interest Rate).

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

propertyTaxRatePct.quote: For this study, county taxes are calculated as 1 percent of the average value of the property.

machineLaborFactor.quote: Labor for operations involving machinery are 20 percent higher than the operation time to account for the extra labor involved in equipment set up, moving, maintenance, work breaks, and field repair.

monthly.quote: MONTHLY CASH COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE ALMONDS

accumulatedNetCost.quote: The cost is $10,109 per acre or $1,010,900 for the 100 acre orchard.

productionYears.quote: The cost is amortized over the remaining 20 years of orchard production to estimate the annual capital recovery cost.

plantingLife.quote: The life of the orchard at the time of planting is estimated to be 23 years.

removalCost.note: Removal of the previous planting, charged as a pre-plant cost in the first establishment year. The studies do not charge an end-of-life removal and set the establishment asset salvage value to zero.

method.quote: The cost is amortized over the remaining 20 years of orchard production to estimate the annual capital recovery cost.
